

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggspatial)  # for north arrow & scale bar
```

# Figure 1 - Map of BC fire centres and fire perimeters for 2023-2025
```{r}
fire_centres_path <- d(cfg$data$plotting$fire_centres)
 
hist_fires_path   <- d(cfg$data$plotting$hist_fires)
 
curr_fires_path   <- d(cfg$data$plotting$curr_fires)
 
```

Read in paths to shapefiles and load them as sf objects.
```{r}
fire_centres <- st_read(fire_centres_path, quiet = TRUE)
hist_fires   <- st_read(hist_fires_path, quiet = TRUE)
curr_fires   <- st_read(curr_fires_path, quiet = TRUE)
```

Filter historical fires to 2023 and 2024

```{r}
fires_2023 <- hist_fires |> 
  filter(FIRE_YEAR == 2023)

fires_2024 <- hist_fires |> 
  filter(FIRE_YEAR == 2024)

fires_2025 <- curr_fires
```

reproject to BC Albers (EPSG:3005)
```{r}
crs_bc <- 3005
 
fire_centres <- st_transform(fire_centres, crs_bc)
fires_2023   <- st_transform(fires_2023,   crs_bc)
fires_2024   <- st_transform(fires_2024,   crs_bc)
fires_2025   <- st_transform(fires_2025,   crs_bc)
```

colour palette


```{r}
centre_colours <- c(
  "Cariboo"      = "#F5E6C8",   # pale tan/cream
  "Coastal"      = "#F4C8A0",   # peach-orange
  "Kamloops"     = "#C8D8F0",   # light blue
  "Northwest"    = "#B8C8E8",   # muted blue
  "Prince George"= "#C8E0C8",   # light green
  "Southeast"    = "#D8C8E8"    # lavender
)
 
# Fire perimeter fills — bold, match original legend
fire_colours <- c(
  "2023" = "#FFD966",   # yellow
  "2024" = "#E08030",   # orange
  "2025" = "#C0281C"    # red
)

unique(fire_centres$centre_name)
names(centre_colours)
```


prepare fire layers with labels


```{r}
fires_2023$year <- "2023"
fires_2024$year <- "2024"
fires_2025$year <- "2025"
 
# Keep only geometry + year for a clean bind
fires_all <- bind_rows(
  fires_2023 %>% select(year) %>% st_as_sf(),
  fires_2024 %>% select(year) %>% st_as_sf(),
  fires_2025 %>% select(year) %>% st_as_sf()
)
 
fires_all$year <- factor(fires_all$year, levels = c("2023", "2024", "2025"))
```

Get fire centre name column


```{r}
names(fire_centres)
fire_centres <- fire_centres %>%
  rename(centre_name = MFFRCNTRNM)|>
  mutate(centre_name = stringr::str_replace(centre_name, " Fire Centre", ""))  # remove trailing space


```

Build the map


```{r}
p_main <- ggplot() +
 
  geom_sf(
    data      = fire_centres,
    aes(fill  = centre_name, colour = centre_name),
    colour    = centre_colours,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha     = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Fire Centres",
    values = centre_colours,
    guide_legend(
      order        = 2,
      override.aes = list(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
  ) +
 
  new_scale_fill() +
 
  geom_sf(
    data     = fires_all,
    aes(fill = year),
    colour   = "gray30",
    alpha    = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Fire Year",
    values = fire_colours,
    labels = c("2023", "2024", "2025"),
    guide  = guide_legend(
      order        = 1,
      override.aes = list(colour = NA)
    )
  ) +geom_sf_label(
  data          = fire_centres |> filter(centre_name != "Northwest"),
  aes(label     = centre_name),
  size          = 3,
  colour        = "grey30",
  fill          = alpha("white", 0.6),
  label.size    = 0,
  label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")
) +
geom_sf_label(
  data          = fire_centres |> filter(centre_name == "Northwest"),
  aes(label     = centre_name),
  size          = 3,
  colour        = "grey30",
  fill          = alpha("white", 0.6),
  label.size    = 0,
  label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
  nudge_y       = 15500  # adjust up/down here
) +
 
 annotation_north_arrow(
  location    = "tr",
  which_north = "true",
  pad_x       = unit(0.25, "in"),
  pad_y       = unit(2.3, "in"),   # distance down from top edge — tune this
    style       = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
    fill      = c("grey30", "white"),
    line_col  = "grey30",
    text_col  = "grey30",
    text_size = 8
  )
) +
  annotation_scale(
    location   = "br",
    width_hint = 0.3,
    pad_x      = unit(0.3, "in"),
    pad_y      = unit(0.12, "in"),
    text_cex   = 0.7,
    line_col   = "grey30",
    text_col   = "grey30"
  ) +
 
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +

 
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title           = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13,
                                        margin = margin(b = 6), hjust = 0),
    plot.caption         = element_text(colour = "grey50", size = 8,
                                        hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 6)),
    plot.margin          = margin(12, 12, 12, 12),
    plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.position      = c(0.95, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.spacing.y     = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    legend.key.size      = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.box           = "vertical",
    legend.box.spacing   = unit(0.1, "cm")
  )
 p_main
```

```{r}
ggsave(here::here("visualizations", "maps", "Fig1_bc_fire_map.png"), p_main, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

Inset map of Canada with BC highlighted

```{r}
canada    <- ne_states(country = "Canada", returnclass = "sf")
 
# Reproject to Canada Lambert Conformal Conic — looks good for the whole country
crs_canada <- "+proj=lcc +lat_1=49 +lat_2=77 +lat_0=63 +lon_0=-92 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs"
 
canada_proj  <- st_transform(canada, crs_canada)
 
# Highlight BC
bc_highlight <- canada_proj %>% filter(name == "British Columbia")
 
p_inset <- ggplot() +
 
  # Canadian provinces — all muted grey
  geom_sf(data = canada_proj, fill = "#D4D4D4", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
 
  # BC highlighted in a warm amber to stand out
  geom_sf(data = bc_highlight, fill = "green", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
 
  # Crop to Canada + a bit of northern USA
  coord_sf(
    xlim   = c(-3e6, 3.2e6),
    ylim   = c(-1.5e6, 3.5e6),
    expand = FALSE,
    crs    = crs_canada
  ) +
 
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.margin      = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

 
```

clip to zones
```{r}
study_union <- st_union(study_zones)   # single polygon for clipping
 
# 1950-2022: keep only fires fully WITHIN the study zones
clip_within <- function(x) {
  x <- st_make_valid(x)
  x[st_within(x, study_union, sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ]
}
 
# 2023-2025: keep fires that INTERSECT the study zones (then clip geometry)
# 2023-2025: keep fires that INTERSECT the study zones, but retain full geometry
clip_intersect <- function(x) {
  x <- st_make_valid(x)
  x[st_intersects(x, study_union, sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ]
}
 
 
fires_hist <- hist_fires %>% filter(FIRE_YEAR <= 2022) %>% clip_within()
fires_2023 <- hist_fires %>% filter(FIRE_YEAR == 2023) %>% clip_intersect()
fires_2024 <- hist_fires %>% filter(FIRE_YEAR == 2024) %>% clip_intersect()
fires_2025 <- curr_fires                               %>% clip_intersect()
```

```{r}
fires_2024  <- st_transform(fires_2024,  crs_bc)
fires_2025  <- st_transform(fires_2025,  crs_bc)
```

## 1. Reusable scale and layer structure

```{r}
ignition_layer <- function(spring_chain) {
  pts <- spring_chain %>%
    mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
           y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()

  geom_point(
    data   = pts,
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = transition),
    shape  = IGNITION_SHAPE,
    size   = IGNITION_SIZE
  )
}

ignition_scale <- function() {
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = "Overwintering Ignition",
    values = HOTSPOT_PAL,
    guide  = guide_legend(
      order        = 2,
      override.aes = list(shape = IGNITION_SHAPE, size = IGNITION_SIZE)
    )
  )
}
```

## 2. Build zoomed in panel's of the chains - one chain first


```{r}
build_chain_panel <- function(i, chains, fires_crop, spring_sf, study_zones,
                               zone_colours, PERIM_PAL, pad = BBOX_PAD) {

  fid_23 <- chains$fire_id_2023[i]
  fid_24 <- chains$fire_id_2024[i]
  fid_25 <- chains$fire_id_2025[i]

  fires_chain  <- fires_crop |> filter(fire_id %in% c(fid_23, fid_24, fid_25))
  spring_chain <- spring_sf  |> filter(fire_id %in% c(fid_24, fid_25))

  # tighter bbox -- zoom to just the fires + small pad
  bbox_zoom <- st_bbox(fires_chain)
  bbox_zoom <- st_bbox(
    c(xmin = unname(bbox_zoom["xmin"]) - pad,
      ymin = unname(bbox_zoom["ymin"]) - pad,
      xmax = unname(bbox_zoom["xmax"]) + pad,
      ymax = unname(bbox_zoom["ymax"]) + pad),
    crs = st_crs(4326)
  )



  zones_zoom <- study_zones_wgs |>
    st_crop(st_as_sfc(bbox_zoom)) |>
    group_by(MFFRZNNM) |>
    summarise()

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = zones_zoom, aes(fill = MFFRZNNM),
            colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Fire Zones", values = zone_colours,
                       guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_sf(data = fires_chain, aes(fill = chain_class),
            colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Fire perimeter", values = PERIM_PAL,
                       guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    ignition_layer(spring_chain) +
    ignition_scale() +
    coord_sf(crs = 4326,
             xlim = c(bbox_zoom["xmin"], bbox_zoom["xmax"]),
             ylim = c(bbox_zoom["ymin"], bbox_zoom["ymax"]),
             expand = FALSE) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(
      legend.position       = "right",
      legend.justification  = c(0, 1),
      legend.box            = "vertical",
      legend.box.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.spacing    = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      legend.background     = element_blank(),
      legend.key            = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
      plot.title             = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
    )

  p
}
```

```{r}
st_crs(study_zones)
st_crs(bbox_zoom)

```

## 3. Build all five individual chains based on previous code

```{r}
chain_indices <- 1:5

plot_list <- lapply(chain_indices, function(i) {
  build_chain_panel(
    i            = i,
    chains       = chains,
    fires_crop   = fires_crop,
    spring_sf    = spring_sf,
    study_zones  = study_zones_wgs,
    zone_colours = zone_colours,
    PERIM_PAL    = PERIM_PAL
  )
})

# panels for use as insets (no legend, thin border) vs standalone (own legend)
panels_no_legend <- lapply(plot_list, function(p) {
  p + theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey40",
                                     linewidth = 0.4)
  )
})

legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  plot_list[[1]] + theme(legend.position = "right")
)

# to get plots run the following ex.: p_5 <- plot_list[[5]] + theme(legend.position = "right"); p_5
```

## 4. Main map -- using ignition markers (part 2) + chain-centroid labels
## figure_2: base fire build earlier

```{r}
chain_centroids <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(chains)), function(i) {
  fires_crop |>
    filter(fire_id %in% c(chains$fire_id_2023[i],
                           chains$fire_id_2024[i],
                           chains$fire_id_2025[i])) |>
    st_union() |>
    st_centroid() |>
    st_coordinates() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(chain = i)
}) |> bind_rows()

p_main_annotated <- figure_2 +
  geom_point(
    data   = chain_centroids,
    aes(x = X, y = Y),
    colour = "black", size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data    = chain_centroids,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = letters[chain]),
    size    = 3, fontface = "bold",
    nudge_x = 0.15, nudge_y = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

```

## 6. Place arrows (as accurate as possible) from each inset edge to its chain centroid on the main map

```{r}
PROJ_CRS <- 3005  # BC Albers

chain_centroids_proj <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(chains)), function(i) {
  fires_crop |>
    st_transform(PROJ_CRS) |>
    filter(fire_id %in% c(chains$fire_id_2023[i],
                           chains$fire_id_2024[i],
                           chains$fire_id_2025[i])) |>
    st_union() |>
    st_centroid() |>
    st_coordinates() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(chain = i)
}) |> bind_rows()

p_main_bare <- p_main_annotated +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

p_main_built <- ggplot_build(p_main_bare)
main_xlim    <- p_main_built$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x_range
main_ylim    <- p_main_built$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y_range

to_canvas_frac <- function(x, y, xlim, ylim) {
  data.frame(
    cx = (x - xlim[1]) / diff(xlim),
    cy = (y - ylim[1]) / diff(ylim)
  )
}

centroid_canvas <- to_canvas_frac(
  chain_centroids_proj$X,
  chain_centroids_proj$Y,
  main_xlim, main_ylim
)

# arrows
# for each inset, choose the start point on its border that's
# closest to the corresponding centroid on the main map 

nearest_edge_point <- function(pos, w, h, tx, ty) {
  # candidate points: midpoints of all four edges
  candidates <- data.frame(
    x = c(pos$x, pos$x + w, pos$x + w / 2, pos$x + w / 2),
    y = c(pos$y + h / 2, pos$y + h / 2, pos$y + h, pos$y)
  )
  d <- sqrt((candidates$x - tx)^2 + (candidates$y - ty)^2)
  candidates[which.min(d), ]
}

# arrows
arrow_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(inset_positions), function(i) {
  pos <- inset_positions[[i]]

  if (i %in% c(4, 5)) {
    # d and e: always originate from the LEFT edge, pointing toward the main map
    start <- data.frame(x = pos$x, y = pos$y + inset_h / 2)
  } else {
    # a, b, c: use nearest-edge logic as before
    start <- nearest_edge_point(
      pos, inset_w, inset_h,
      centroid_canvas$cx[i], centroid_canvas$cy[i]
    )
  }

  data.frame(
    x    = start$x,
    y    = start$y,
    xend = centroid_canvas$cx[i],
    yend = centroid_canvas$cy[i]
  )
}))

```

## 7. Put the final plot together 

```{r}
canvas <- ggdraw(p_main_bare)

for (i in seq_along(inset_positions)) {
  pos <- inset_positions[[i]]
  canvas <- canvas +
    draw_plot(
      panels_no_legend[[i]],
      x = pos$x, y = pos$y,
      width = inset_w, height = inset_h
    )
}

canvas <- canvas +
  geom_segment(
    data        = arrow_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    arrow       = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    colour      = "grey20",
    linewidth   = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

for (i in seq_along(inset_positions)) {
  pos <- inset_positions[[i]]
  canvas <- canvas +
    draw_label(
      letters[i],
      x        = pos$x + 0.01,
      y        = pos$y + inset_h - 0.01,
      fontface = "bold", size = 10,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1
    )
}
canvas <- canvas +
  cowplot::draw_grob(legend_grob, x = 0.30, y = 0.02, width = 0.25, height = 0.35)

canvas
```

```{r}
hotspots_2025_2024 <- hotspots_2025_2024 %>% mutate(year_label = "2025")
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

# Define the zoom bbox around the NE cluster — adjust these to taste
# Zoom bbox — targeting the NE cluster (top-right of your map)
hotspot_bbox <- st_bbox(hotspots_all)
pad_inset <- 10000   # metres padding around hotspot extent

zoom_xlim <- c(hotspot_bbox["xmin"] - pad_inset, hotspot_bbox["xmax"] + pad_inset)
zoom_ylim <- c(hotspot_bbox["ymin"] - pad_inset, hotspot_bbox["ymax"] + pad_inset)
# Build the inset plot — same layers, just zoomed in
inset <- ggplot() +

  geom_sf(
    data      = study_zones,
    aes(fill  = MFFRZNNM),
    colour    = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha     = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_colours, guide = "none") +

  new_scale_fill() +

  geom_sf(
    data      = fires_2023,
    aes(fill  = as.character(FIRE_YEAR)),
    colour    = "black",
    alpha     = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colours, guide = "none") +

  geom_point(
    data = hotspots_all %>%
             mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
                    y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
             st_drop_geometry(),
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = year_label),
    fill   = NA,
    shape  = 21,
    size   = 2,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("2024" = "#3079e0", "2025" = "#930cb8"),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +

  # Red box outline to show zoom extent (optional — remove if you don't want it)
  annotate("rect",
    xmin = zoom_xlim[1], xmax = zoom_xlim[2],
    ymin = zoom_ylim[1], ymax = zoom_ylim[2],
    colour = "red", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    xlim   = zoom_xlim,
    ylim   = zoom_ylim,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "red", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

# Add a red rectangle on the main map showing where the inset is
figure_4_with_box <- figure_4 +
  annotate("rect",
    xmin = zoom_xlim[1], xmax = zoom_xlim[2],
    ymin = zoom_ylim[1], ymax = zoom_ylim[2],
    colour = "red", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8
  )

# Compose with patchwork — inset placed top-right
figure_4_final <- figure_4_with_box | inset +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))   # main map twice as wide as inset

figure_4_final
```
